name: [Anypoint MQ] Exporter Scrape Errors
message:
{{#is_alert}}
❗ **Anypoint MQ Exporter is experiencing repeated scrape failures**

{{value}} scrape errors in the last 15 minutes.

**Possible causes:**
- Anypoint Platform API outage or rate limiting
- Connected App credentials expired or revoked
- Network connectivity issues to anypoint.mulesoft.com
- Exporter application resource issues (OOM, thread exhaustion)

**Actions:**
1. Check exporter logs: `kubectl logs -l app=anypoint-mq-exporter`
2. Verify Anypoint Platform status: https://status.mulesoft.com
3. Test API credentials manually
4. Check exporter health endpoint: `/actuator/health`

@slack-mulesoft-alerts
